featured_reviews.name: varun kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Used to be one of the very well maintained joggers track till about 2019 however the park is not being maintained now.
You can see a lot of debris and construction materials lying around.
The park is still used by local for jogging, walking and relaxation by senior citizens.
It is still amongst the good tracks for fitness enthusiast in this area.
Pond is the major attraction at the joggers park, making the the walk/run worthwhile. You can also see a lot of kids and families feeding fishes, turtles and ducks in the pond.
You do have place to sit around the pond incase you just want to enjoy your time with family and friends.

featured_reviews.name: Hiral Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: This jogging track is one of the worst maintained one I have seen in Borivali. It does provide solace and serenity to the people residing nearby and the lake at the centre offers some beautiful natural views. Other than that , this place disappoints due to sheer lack of maintenance

featured_reviews.review_text: It's a very nice well maintained Joggers Park. Good for jogging, walking only. Not for children and family activities. It has drinking water facility, outdoor speakers playing music. Clean.

featured_reviews.review_text: A good and peaceful place to jog and workout in the morning around the pond and once you are done just sit and watch the fishes moving in water. But some sort of rule should be made for keeping the pond water clean as one may  find plastic wrappers and beer bottle.

featured_reviews.name: Jayant Wankhede
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went with my friends to this place. We ordered too many dishes exactly at one time because we were hungry.
But this place is to much hot in summer & the food quality is very poor as we felt and what we felt we just mentioned in this review.
.
We ordered :-
.
• Fried Prawns - We don't realize that prawns had any taste. Even prawns were not fried good. We ignore it.
.
• Chicken Kheema - These is also same. No taste of kheema. We not even felt that kheema was spicy or not. We just knew kheema was hot and not have taste. After having this we fully disappointed. Our Last hope was Chinese only.
.
• Roti - Even roti also not cooked well. We complaint abut this to restaurant member. They were ready to replace but we ate half actually so we leave it.
.
• Hakka Noodles - It was okay to eat. So we had it becoz we don't have any option.
.
• Triple Schezwan Noodles - Quite Okay.

I am not suggesting this place to anyone. Our money was fully wasted and not even felt that we actually ate something. Very bad experience.

We specialize in borewell drilling, rainwater harvesting systems, combination wells, ring wells, groundwater recharge, and water infrastructure services.
